SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.

   D. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   B. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.
   D. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   B. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   C. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.

   D. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   B. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)

   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.

   C. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

16. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

----
